timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: NEUTRAL timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,497–1,500 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently around 1,500 KRW per dollar—moderately weak but stabilizing. SK Hynix's $26.5 billion inflow is expected to strengthen the won (lower the rate) going forward, suggesting the exchange rate may improve for your dollar purchases soon, but the immediate effect is still uncertain and foreign selling is currently pressuring rates upward.

TIP: Given stabilization is expected within days/weeks from the large capital inflow, consider waiting a few days if possible before your monthly conversion, as the won may strengthen and reduce your conversion cost.
